oracle: `npm ls --omit=dev --all --long --json --workspace <app>`, names and versions read from each listed path's own package.json; the workspace packages themselves left out.
notes: npm does not support the `workspace:` protocol, so apps/api declares "@acme/shared": "*". npm links it as node_modules/@acme/shared -> ../../packages/shared: a real path outside node_modules, which is what makes it a local package under §5. Root devDependency is-number is installed and must not be reported. Installed on Linux aarch64 in Docker.
